title: The Glass Garden
blurb: A cozy tale of frosted bakery windows and the quiet magic that keeps Loki's Town warm on a chilly day.

title: The Moth Who Wanted to See the Stars
blurb: A tiny moth discovers that even when the clouds hide the night sky, a little bit of starlight can be found hanging from the branches in Loki’s Town.

title: Pip's First Frost
blurb: Pip the tiny mouse steps outside to discover a sparkling world of crystalline frost for the very first time.

title: The Winter Holly Wreath
blurb: Loki and Pip search through every cozy corner of town to find the warmest, most welcoming home for their handmade holiday wreath.

title: The Silver Soft-Falling Night
blurb: Loki and Pip discover that even a cloudy evening can turn into a magical adventure when the first snowflakes start to dance over the plaza.
